graft.title: Record the licensing files so projects can choose a combo
graft.need: licensing/ (combos.toml, contributing.md, LICENSE.md.tmpl, texts/, agreements/) is committed at f46f07a but not recorded in the baseline's signed log: `tend doc record --check` lists all eight as unrecorded, so `tend baseline license choose library` in a project fails with 'vg-paradigms has no licensing (licensing/combos.toml)'. Record them (`tend doc record`) and commit.
graft.use_case: autodyne adopts the library combo (GPL-3.0-only with the Open Project Exception, OR royalty-free, OR commercial): tend baseline license choose library, then tend baseline render for LICENSE.md, LICENSES/ and REUSE.toml.
